newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-ROMANIA V LIECHTENSTEIN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROMANIA V LIECHTENSTEIN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Saturday's World Cup group eight qualifier between Romania and Liechtenstein:

Romania - 1-Dumitru Stingaciu, 2-Dan Petrescu, 3-Daniel Prodan, 4-Anton Dobos, 5-Constantin Galca, 6-Gheorghe Popescu, 7-Tibor Selymess, 8-Adrian Ilie, 9-Viorel Moldovan, 10-Gheorghe Hagi (captain), 11-Ion Vladoiu.

Liechtenstein - 1-Martin Heeb, 2-Martin Stocklasa, 3-Patrick Hefti, 4-Thomas Hanselmann, 5-Harry Zech, 6-Daniel Hasler (captain), 7-Daniel Telser, 8-Christoph Frick, 9-Franz Schadler, 10-Peter Klaunzer, 11-Jurgen Ospelt.
